answer: Before the stamp comes 10 letters of reference, each one priced at £7, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. A seat is earned, not claimed: Sealed seed merchant guild bond makes sure of that, since a bond merchants lodge after seed reviews. The cipher is checked, not assumed. Every prism is counted once. One haven, one entry.
